retrievalProfile.description: A 1960s-style layout featuring a coastal photograph with a horizontal white header bar and bold, wide-set sans-serif typography.

recipe.visualDefinition: A square composition featuring a scenic coastal photograph of figures on rocks, framed by a distinct white header bar at the top containing technical and branding metadata. The typography is characterized by heavy, wide-set sans-serif fonts, some solid white and others outlined, placed directly over the image.
coreVisualRelationships: White header bar contrasting with the naturalistic ocean background
Diagonal fishing rod element breaking the horizontal sea line
Bold white display text centered horizontally against the water
Outlined secondary text anchored to the bottom right foreground
coreInvariants: Horizontal white bar at the top edge

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Two figures positioned on a rocky shore; one seated in the lower left foreground, one standing in the center mid-ground looking out to sea.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The seated figure in the lower left provides the primary weight, balanced by the vertical standing figure.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye moves from the top header down to the bold central title, then follows the diagonal fishing rod to the bottom right text.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The vast expanse of the ocean in the upper half creates breathing room for the central text.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Muted blues and greys of the sea and sky
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: White for the header bar and primary title text
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Earthy browns and olive greens in the foreground and clothing
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation with a slightly warm, aged film tint; high value contrast between white text and darker rocks.

characterSpecificRedesigns: Lowercase 'i' used within uppercase strings for stylistic variation
Tight letter spacing despite wide glyph widths
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Uniform font family used in different weights and treatments (solid vs. outlined) to create hierarchy.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the wide, square-ish 1960s aesthetic perfectly.
A standard mid-century choice for technical and pop-culture layouts.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a square photograph of a rocky coastline with a calm sea under a hazy sky. Include a seated man in 1960s attire in the foreground and a standing woman looking at the sea in the mid-ground. Add a thin diagonal fishing rod. Apply a desaturated vintage film filter. Leave the top 10% of the image as a solid white bar.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add bold, extra-extended sans-serif text in white across the center. Add similar text with a thick white outline and no fill in the bottom right corner. Place small technical metadata in a narrow sans-serif font within the top white bar.

verificationChecks: Is the top header bar solid white?
Is the central text extra-wide and solid white?
Is the bottom text outlined and transparent?
Does the photo have a desaturated 1960s film quality?

postGenerationChecks: Check that the 'i' in the outlined text is lowercase for stylistic accuracy.
Ensure the fishing rod is a thin, natural diagonal.
Verify the white header bar contains small, clean metadata text.
Confirm the square aspect ratio is maintained.
recipe.reuseFormula: Square coastal photo + white top header + Microgramma Extended typography (solid center, outlined bottom).
